item.text:
No additional correctness defect was confirmed in this pass. The remaining `sync_log` state transitions are either covered by the two confirmed synchronization defects or require malformed/non-protocol inputs.

The audit remains at 26 confirmed findings. The strongest current findings are:

- delta-snapshot synchronization incorporating obsolete data,
- `AcceptSync` regressing an already-decided index,
- persistent failed-write leakage and destructive suffix replacement,
- LFU clone value corruption,
- retry duplication after `AppendError::Timeout`,
- LRU bincode deserialization failure.

Full evidence and retained reproductions remain in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
